overview.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IITH) invites bids for a web-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solution to automate its Academic and Administrative functions. The tender utilizes a Quality Cum Cost Based Selection (QCBS) scheme with 70% technical weightage and 30% commercial weightage.

scope.text: The solution must automate Academic and Administrative functions including Finance & Accounts, Stores & Purchases, Asset Management, HRM & Payroll, Estate Management, Project Management, and Asset Maintenance.

Implementation involves porting or integrating data from existing systems, developing Core Modules (15 months) and Other Modules (18 months), and providing Application Maintenance & Enhancement Services (AMES) for three years post-warranty.
Technical evaluation requires a presentation covering Bidder Profile, Project Plan, Functional Mapping, Non-Functional Capabilities, Case Studies, and Proof of Concept (POC) demonstrations.
The Implementing Agency (IA) is responsible for all service deficiencies, third-party components, and subcontractor modules, with prior approval required for any subcontracting activity.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit specific PDF responses for Parts A through E of the Technical Evaluation and provide reference checks for data migration tools.
To qualify for Part F POC demonstrations, bidders must achieve a minimum score of 60% in Parts A to E.
A Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) of 3% of the contract price must be furnished within 15 days, and a Service Level Agreement (SLA) must be executed.
Bidders must declare no previous transgression regarding corrupt practices within the last three years and provide proof of signature identification.

eligibility.text: The Prime Bidder must have experience as an ERP solution providing agency for five or more years and possess valid GST registration.
Part A evaluation requires a minimum of 6 marks out of 10, with technical eligibility thresholds set at a minimum score of 140 for Parts A to E combined.
Bidders must declare no previous transgression regarding corrupt practices or exclusions from tender processes in the last three years.

important_dates.text: Bid Submission Close Date is 15 Mar 2021 at 1700 hrs; Opening of Technical Bids is scheduled for 16 Mar 2021 at 1100 hrs.
The tender and price remain valid for six calendar months from the date of submission.
Security Deposit must be deposited via Bank Guarantee within 15 days of signing the Contract.

commercial_requirements.text: Services are billed on a Time & Material (T&M) basis, with prices quoted in Indian Rupees inclusive of all taxes and support costs.
Payment milestones include releases upon Architecture completion, CRP demos, cross-functional integration, beta release, Go-Live, UAT approval, and warranty periods.
Liquidated Damages will be levied at 1% per month (max 10%) for non-fulfilment of delivery schedules.

important_conditions.text: Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations apply; the IA must not use disclosed data for third-party services.
The Integrity Pact prohibits corrupt practices, requires disclosure of agent payments, and mandates a declaration of no transgressions in the last three years.
Disputes between the IA and IITH shall be resolved by arbitration in Hyderabad/Sangareddy under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
